subtitles.en: A prophet's dialogue with God about violence and faith

descriptions.en: A short prophetic book structured as a dialogue between the prophet and God about the rise of the Babylonians and the suffering of the righteous. It contains the line *the righteous shall live by faith*, later central to Pauline theology.
